j-news-platform-fact-sheet.md.title: News Platform Fact Sheet
j-news-platform-fact-sheet.md.description: How Americans get news continues to evolve as  platforms emerge, like AI chatbots and email newsletters. Find out how often they get news from digital devices.

j-social-media-and-news-fact-sheet.md.title: Social Media and News Fact Sheet
j-social-media-and-news-fact-sheet.md.description: Many Americans use social media for news: About a fifth or more regularly get news on Facebook, YouTube, Instagram and TikTok.

j-news-influencers-fact-sheet.md.title: News Influencers Fact Sheet
j-news-influencers-fact-sheet.md.description: About one-in-five U.S. adults say they regularly get news from news influencers on social media, and this is especially common among younger adults.
